text: The Patriots face the Jaguars this Sunday with their defensive line compromised by injuries—OLB Dre'Mont Jones (shoulder) and rookie LB Quintayvious Hutchins (knee) are ruled out, with Hutchins placed on injured reserve, though CB Carlton Davis III is set to return. On the offensive side, rookie TE Eli Raridon returned to practice, offering an encouraging sign as the team monitors his status for Jacksonville. The Jaguars, meanwhile, are expecting a favorable matchup against a Patriots team that acknowledged it's still "finding ourselves," with Jacksonville hoping to rebound after their worst offensive performance in 11 months led by Trevor Lawrence. Beyond the field, the Patriots have also faced criticism for their clock management late in the second quarter over the past two weeks, an issue the team admits needs immediate correction.
